subject: #211 was already done through W5/W8; three physical defects found by running the TUI, fixed as PRs #279/#280/#281, remainder recorded as #282
result: The pasted handoff (make Graph real, then W1 Navigator) was stale: Graph landed as #218 with #226/#229, Navigator as #221/#228, spec PR #212 merged 2026-09-08, and #211 was closed 2026-09-09 by PR #257 rather than by its criteria. Verified rather than assumed: main at 1f9ef6a, cargo test -p aikit-tui = 29 binaries, 251 passed, 0 failed. Then ran the production TUI on a real terminal for the first time (W10 had never been touched) and found three defects no test could catch. ONE: keystroke-to-repaint of 974-2430 ms because dispatch re-read the whole derived world per keystroke; fixed to 84-89 ms measured the same way, PR #279. TWO: the Relations panel drawn over the resource list without clearing it, so the list bled through the panel - unreadable at 60x30; PR #280, which also deletes 15 orphaned render__*.snap goldens whose test was removed in 50b2669 on 2026-08-16. THREE: V2SurfaceService, the decorator every interactive entry point wraps Service in, never forwarded versioned_world or project_binding, so the TUI had never seen Git despite NativeGitProvider being complete and tested; PR #281 forwards both, renders branch/head/upstream/working-state/worktrees in Worlds, and fixes a System-pane line that was printing the internal note about with_credential_world to the user. WHAT REMAINS, recorded as #282 with receipts: W6 is entirely unimplemented (aikit-tui does not depend on aikit-adapters, so tmux/cmux/Herdr are unreachable - zero Open/Focus actions exist); W7s System pane renders real code with no producer (disclose_credential_world has no production call site at all), and doctor/gateway/credential-setup are absent from the TUI; W3s Continue/Start-simple-session/Repair each need an owner contract that does not exist (#227); W9 has golden coverage for one of six destinations; W10 is otherwise unrun. Physical items now proven: terminal restore passes clean, glyph capability detects UTF-8 vs ASCII correctly per host, and 60x30 truncates the destination bar and footer rather than progressively disclosing. OPERATIONAL WARNING for the next parallel run: three agents sharing one CARGO_TARGET_DIR across separate worktrees produced stale test binaries reporting pre-fix results with no recompile; it hit all three independently. Give each worktree its own target dir or serialise builds.
